finding.summary: A DID route can match multiple active SIP deployments because no database invariant prevents duplicate phone values and the current lookup selects an arbitrary record.
finding.risk: Nondeterministic duplicate DID selection can route a call and authentication metadata to the wrong assistant or tenant.
required_resolution: Require exactly one active SIP deployment match for a DID route value.
Reject zero matches as route not found.
Reject multiple matches as ambiguous configuration before selecting tenant or assistant.
Add duplicate DID tests across assistants and tenants.

cycle_limit.result: Implementation and confirmation are blocked pending owner escalation and a fresh governed run.
